review_comments.body: Maybe `/^(.*?)(px|in|cm|mm|q|pt|pc)?$/I` plus `is_numeric($matches[1])` would be easier to read and also not allow a trailing dot like `5.` which the PR currently would allow.

comments.body: Hi, just a gentle ping on this one in case it slipped through. Happy to adjust anything if needed. Thanks!
@pcbeingused333 We are currently wrapping up our v6 release which has us quite busy. We will get back to reviewing your PR once we have that done, sorry for the delay.

Follow-up reply to review on #8769:

Thanks, switched `Svg::length()` to your suggestion: a lazy `^(\S*?)(px|in|cm|mm|pt|pc|q)?$` match plus `is_numeric($matches[1])` (`\S` rather than `.` so `5 px` stays rejected, as PHP 8's `is_numeric()` accepts trailing whitespace). Since `is_numeric('5.')` is true in PHP, a trailing dot is rejected explicitly, and a test row (`5.` / `5.px`) covers it. Used the `i` flag, as `/I` isn't a PCRE modifier.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
